name: Fiberon PPS-CF10 @Qidi X-Plus 4 0.8 nozzle
filament_notes:
Fiberon manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 100 C for 10 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed 6 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
Hotend must reach 310 C+ (300 C possible only very slowly). Hardened nozzle. No heated chamber required; TDS chamber: room temp, wiki ambient 25-80 C acceptable. Fan OFF. Low moisture sensitivity but store <20% RH. Very brittle on spool: straight filament path, avoid AMS. Internal FR test shows V0 behaviour but not UL94 certified. Black; 0.5 kg and 3 kg spools. Support: PolySupport for PA12.
Source: https://fiberon.polymaker.com/wp-content/uploads/TDS_FIBERON-PPS-CF10_V1.1_EN.pdf
